profile.headline: Software Engineer II at JPMorganChase.
profile.summary: Full time Software Engineer with intellectual curiosity, desire to deliver, and eagerness to keep growing professionally. Approachable and communicative, with a strong sense of collaboration, accountability for work, and attention to detail. Knowledgeable about object-oriented programming, Data Structures, Algorithms, and computer science.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
• Equities Sales & Trading - UI Toolkit integration within Corporate and Investment Banking - Markets Technology.
• Developing desktop and web applications used for order management / monitoring by the NY market branch.
• L3 support for Equities Sales & Trading.
• Cybersecurity - Monorepo dependency management, fixing vulnerabilities and exploitable parts of the codebase.
• Quality assessment testing. Application deployments to UAT, PROD and other environments.
• Helping with training and onboarding new team members.
• Documentation and guide preparation using Confluence and other Atlassian's team collaboration software
• React typescript, js, css.

positions.title: Student
positions.description: Projects for major courses applying agile scrum principles, including Advanced Programming, Data Structures, Analysis & Design of Algorithms, Human-Computer Interactions (UI for mobile apps), Intro to Software Engineering (SWE), SW Reliability Testing, SWE requirements, SW Design, Computer Networks, Databases, Operating Systems, High Performance Computing, and Capstone Project.

positions.title: SEP Software Engineer Summer Intern
positions.description:
• Data visualization tools for an order monitoring Desktop application and website using TypeScript / ReactJs.
• Used Highcharts libraries and practiced applying functional style programming best practices.
• Contributions deployed to PROD.
• Agile development.

positions.title: SEP Software Engineer Summer Intern
positions.description:
• Using Java/Spring Boot, developed endpoints for a BFF REST API that integrates a website application functions into a desktop app, making 20,000 users save time. 
• Wrote JUnit tests for line coverage. 
• Deployed the updated REST API to the user acceptance testing (UAT) environment using Jenkins Pipeline. 
• Applied agile development practices using Atlassian Suite tools like Jira Software, Confluence, and Bitbucket.
